shared_policy_rules.semantic_state: joint belief over persistent target identity, world membership, and explicit target absence
shared_policy_rules.observable_task_state: covered or open; tracked separately from semantic belief and updated from executed-action outcomes
shared_policy_rules.candidate_match_boundary: Qwen native match-minus-nonmatch logit at zero; this is an observation symbol boundary, not a grasp-confidence threshold
shared_policy_rules.terminal_scoring: A grasp succeeds semantically only when persistent candidate identity and world membership both match the held-out simulator label. Target-absent is correct only when the policy defers.
shared_policy_rules.terminal_decision_rule: minimum finite-horizon expected task cost over every feasible grasp and defer action

proposed_task_risk_aware_joint_belief_mp.belief: calibration-frozen joint posterior over persistent target identity, membership, and target absence
proposed_task_risk_aware_joint_belief_mp.action_selection: finite-horizon expected task cost over grasp, defer, remove-cover, close-high view, and right view
proposed_task_risk_aware_joint_belief_mp.future_observation_model: calibration-frozen action-conditioned likelihood, conditioned after cover removal by current post-remove RGB-D/Qwen features

immediate_grasp.action_selection: force the feasible grasp action with the largest posterior semantic mass; never defer and never collect another observation

fixed_right_view.belief: same frozen belief update and terminal task-risk decision as proposed
fixed_right_view.action_selection: when terminal decision defers, remove the cover if required, then take right first and close-high only if still deferred

fixed_close_high_view.belief: same frozen belief update and terminal task-risk decision as proposed
fixed_close_high_view.action_selection: when terminal decision defers, remove the cover if required, then take close-high first and right only if still deferred

confidence_greedy.belief: no calibrated posterior; use Qwen native match decision and top membership label from the current observation
confidence_greedy.action_selection: grasp the current persistent track at the first positive match with inside/outside membership; otherwise remove cover if required, then use right followed by close-high

myopic_information_gain.action_selection: if task-risk terminal planning defers, select the single action with maximum expected one-step entropy reduction, ignoring downstream task cost, and re-evaluate after the observation

open_loop_belief_planner.belief: same frozen posterior after the center observation as proposed
open_loop_belief_planner.action_selection: plan an action sequence from model-predicted maximum-likelihood outcomes and ignore every later semantic observation

random_feasible_action.action_selection: sample reproducibly from currently feasible information and terminal actions without semantic evidence

oracle_simulator_ground_truth.action_selection: post-hoc upper bound: grasp the correct outside target immediately, remove cover then grasp the correct inside target, and defer when target is absent

no_joint_belief.change_from_proposed: after every update, replace the target-present joint posterior by the product of its persistent-identity and membership marginals while preserving target-absence mass

no_calibration.change_from_proposed: replace fitted observation likelihoods for received evidence with direct sigmoid-normalized Qwen match logits and hard top relation labels; retain task-risk planning and future-belief rollout

no_negative_evidence.change_from_proposed: ignore every no-target-evidence observation by leaving the semantic posterior unchanged

no_action_conditioned_future_belief.change_from_proposed: do not evaluate future observation branches; after a task-risk defer choose the lower motion-cost available information action

no_task_risk_cost.change_from_proposed: select observations by entropy reduction and force the maximum-posterior feasible grasp at termination, without wrong-commitment or execution-risk costs

no_persistent_tracking.change_from_proposed: map every matched candidate in a new view to the center-selected identity before belief update

no_scene_conditioned_view_model.change_from_proposed: retain the calibration-frozen pooled view likelihoods and do not condition them on post-remove RGB-D/Qwen features
